newsitem.title: USA: Manor Care to spin off Choice Hotels Nov 1.
newsitem.headline: Manor Care to spin off Choice Hotels Nov 1.

text.p: Manor Care Inc said the Form 10 registration statement of its soon-to-be spun off Choice Hotels was declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Form 10 relates to the securities to be issued by Choice Hotels in the separation of Manor Care's lodging business from the health care business via a tax-free spin off to Manor Care shareholders.
The company said "when issued" trading began Wednesday and will continue through the November 1 distribution date.
The company said Manor Care shareholders will receive one share of Choice Hotels for every Manor Care share held on October 10.
